items.name: The $.$. Rocky
items.description: A$AP Rocky's battleship moored on the shore — home of the season's first boss, with mounted cannons and a Choppa on board.
items.rationale: Boss drop plus a Choppa make it the strongest loot and fastest exit on the map, but it will be the hottest drop of launch week — risky in tournaments. A metal ship deck won't give many materials.

items.name: Loguetown
items.description: A dense town on the northern shore of the southern bay, with roads running out in several directions.
items.rationale: One chest guide counts 41 chest spawns, and a vault sits in the aqueduct sewers. Luffy and Usopp both give free Rifts, so you can launch toward the next zone straight off the drop. It's central and busy: post-launch guides agree it gets crowded.

items.name: Lantern Landing
items.description: A lantern-lit maze of streets just north of the unexplained purple ring, close to the middle of the island.
items.rationale: The highest chest count in post-launch guides (46 to 50+ spawns), plus a vault on the east side and the Frog Statue puzzle just south, which spawns two Rare Chests. Every chest guide puts it first or second, so expect a crowd. Rotations stay short from near the middle.

items.name: Arlong Park
items.description: One Piece's fish-man stronghold: a walled compound with a tiered tower, linked to the mainland by a single bridge.
items.rationale: Guides count 39 to 40+ chest spawns packed into a small compound. Zoro's free Rift is a second way out besides the single bridge, so getting trapped is less of a risk. It sits on the western edge, and guides call it a quieter start.

items.name: Rubber Resort
items.description: A resort on its own island with a duck-shaped yacht, joined by a bridge toward the northern desert. Cap'n Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto arrive here on 15 November.
items.rationale: games.gg counts 47 regular chest spawns plus 6 Rare Chest spawns, the most on the map, and a vault on the west beach, so the loot is far better than first thought. It's isolated in the far north-west, which keeps it a quieter start, but the only way out is a long rotation over a single bridge. More players may land here now that chest guides recommend it.

items.name: The Chest
items.description: A cluster of islets west of the northern desert, built around buried treasure: games.gg counts 34 buried chest spawns and 10 regular ones (GameRant: 20+).

items.name: Loot Lagoon
items.description: Where the river meets the northern coast. games.gg counts 26 chest spawns and 4 Rare Chest spawns.

items.name: Lil' Uzi's Stronghold
items.description: A walled fort at the edge of the desert in the north-east, east of Loot Lagoon. The in-game label is Fortune's Fort. Since 8 November Lil Uzi Vert holds its west side as a boss. games.gg counts 33 chest spawns and 10 Wanted Poster spawns.
highlights: Boss: Lil Uzi Vert (Exotic Lil' SMG)
Map Fragment #2 in the shack to the south-east
items.rationale: 33 chest spawns plus a boss that drops the Exotic Lil' SMG and a guaranteed Lil' Uzi Vert Jr. Sprite, so the loot is close to The $.$. Rocky's. Guides call it a hot zone since the boss arrived, so expect contested landings. Kawaii Team Leader's free Medic and Rift give a way out. Materials and rotation are provisional until competitive drop maps cover it.

items.name: Cursed Cavern
items.description: A dark crater in the green zone, centre-east, built into a hill. Guides count 25 to 28 chest spawns and call it a relatively safe drop.
highlights: 13 Wanted Poster spawns (most on the map)

items.name: Windmill Village
items.description: Luffy's home town from One Piece, on an island linked to the mainland. Buccaneer Brigand Jones offers a free Heavy Specialist, and Nami gives a free Rift on the beach to the south. games.gg counts 29 chest spawns plus a Rare Chest spawn.

items.name: Plunder Port
items.description: Docks on the south coast with two multi-floor ships moored offshore. GameRant counts 30+ chest spawns, most of them on the south side.

items.name: Busy Bay
items.description: Two connected islands in the south-east corner. Sanji gives a free Rift here. games.gg counts 29 chest spawns and 4 Rare Chest spawns.
